spanish: O alma que tocare en toda cosa impura, o en cadáver de bestia viva impura, o en cadáver de animal impuro, o en cadáver de reptil impuro, y se ocultare desde él, y él impuro, y culpado.
readerNote: hold: clause role — the suffix on מִמֶּנּוּ is tagged 1st person common plural ("from us") in the packet while the draft treats it as 3rd person singular ("desde él"); deciding whom the preposition governs is a participant question, not grammar, so the draft Spanish is returned unchanged.
